description:
Create a video lesson from a document (use when someone wants a document turned into a video)

Use when the user brings a document, PDF, deck, page or text and wants a video, a lesson, an explainer or a summary video of it. Send the file as multipart, or `text`/`url` as JSON. Returns a lesson id immediately; nothing renders until approve_lesson, so creating costs no minutes. Follow it with get_lesson until the storyboard needs approval. With an Idempotency-Key the same request inside 24h returns the same lesson (same key, different body is 409).

file_path.description: Path to a local file on this machine (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, MD, TXT; max 50 MB).

format.description: Video format. GET /v1/formats lists the live set.

text.description: The lesson text itself (UTF-8, max 5 MB).

url.description: A public http(s) page; its readable text becomes the document.

name: create_lesson
